title: La Comédie Française (FCP 2026)
synopsis: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never cancelled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在歷史悠久的法蘭西喜劇院,有一條黃金規則：演出永不取消。不幸的是，對Nina來說，就在她首次執導作品的首演前三小時，接連出現大亂子! 一名演員被困在火車上、緊繃的情緒一觸即發、器材故障、自尊心引發衝突,恐慌已蔓延至整個後台。不知如何解決，時間又一分一秒溜走，Nina必須不惜一切代價撐住整場演出。她能否撐到幕簾升起呢?

cast: Pauline Clément, Laurent Stocker, Julien Frison, Marina Hands, Benjamin Lavernhe
